hero.title: Senim — a developmental support centre for children and teenagers
hero.subtitle: We help children grow their speech, communication, attention, movement and independence in a calm, supportive environment.

audience.subtitle: Every child is unique. We design each programme after the initial consultation.

consultation.body: The programme and cost are defined after the initial consultation and observation. It is a calm conversation in which we get to know the child, agree on goals and pick a comfortable schedule.
